channel.title: San Diego Community Newsgroup - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: Barrio Logan sounds alarm over threat to landmark murals, gentrification
item.description: Displacement of long-time residents of working-class neighborhoods — many of them communities of color — is a hot-button issue across the U.S.

item.title: San Diego Politics Show: Supervisor Monica Montgomery Steppe
item.description: An interview with Supervisor Monica Montgomery Steppe and a discussion on the District 2 City Council race before the June primary.

item.title: Opinion: Serving Seniors turns homeless count into dignity for older adults
item.description: The annual Point in Time Count of San Diego's homeless became an opportunity to immediately connect those counted to desperately needed services.

item.title: Whale entanglements in fishing gear surge off West Coast during heat waves
item.description: New research finds that rising ocean temperatures are shrinking cool-water feeding grounds, pushing humpbacks into gear-heavy waters near shore.

item.title: UCSD fencing joins new pro league to offer athletes more visibility, opportunities
item.description: UCSD has teamed up with the World Fencing League (WFL) in a strategic partnership aimed at giving collegiate fencers more chances to succeed.

item.title: San Diego photographer documents the fans, not the game, at SDFC matches
item.description: Israel Castillo's photo series, "Among the Supporters," now entering its second season alongside San Diego FC, is a document of shared witnessing - the cheers, the beers and a city that has fully united around its young franchise.

item.title: Five questions with Sara Petite: San Diego’s Americana angel has a new album due soon
item.description: Petite, a San Diego Music Award winner, has become a linchpin of the local roots-music community through her “Americana Roundup” series.

item.title: Chamber of Commerce unveils new mission at 155th annual celebration
item.description: At the organization's 155th anniversary celebration, President and CEO Chris Cate unveiled the new mission to "champion business and empower leaders."

item.title: ‘No breaks anywhere’ for San Diego-area restaurateurs — so many are opting to close up shop
item.description: With numerous challenges facing many area restaurants, your next meal at one of your favorite eateries could be your last.

item.title: MarketInk: Greenhaus adds partners, launches behavioral insights product
item.description: Greenhaus now has five partners, including founding partner Craig Fuller, chief executive Paul Whitbeck and chief creative officer Rob Petrie.
